paragraphs.text: Καὶ τότε ὁ ὕψιστος εἶπεν, καὶ ὁ ἅγιος ὁ μέγας ἐλάλησεν, καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Ἀρσυαλαλιοὺρ πρὸς τὸν υἱὸν Λάμεχ,
paragraphs.translit: Kai tote ho hypsistos eipen, kai ho hagios ho megas elalēsen, kai apesteilen Arsyalalalour pros ton huion Lamech,

i18n.en: Then the Most High spoke, and the Holy Great One uttered his word, and he sent Asuryal to the son of Lamech,

paragraphs.text: λέγων· Πορεύου πρὸς τὸν Νῶε καὶ εἰπὲ αὐτῷ τῷ ἐμῷ ὀνόματι· Κρύψον σεαυτόν· καὶ δήλωσον αὐτῷ τέλος ἐπερχόμενον, ὅτι ἡ γῆ πᾶσα ἀπολεῖται, καὶ τὸ ὕδωρ τοῦ κατακλυσμοῦ μέλλει γενέσθαι ἐπὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν, καὶ ἀπολέσει πάντα τὰ ἐν αὐτῇ.
paragraphs.translit: legōn; Poreuou pros ton Nōe kai eipe autō tō emō onomati; Krypson seauton; kai dēlōson autō telos eperchomenon, hoti hē gē pasa apoleitai, kai to hydōr tou kataklysmou mellei genesthai epi pasan tēn gēn, kai apolesei panta ta en autē.

i18n.en: saying: Go to Noah, and say to him in my name: Hide yourself. And reveal to him the end that is coming, for the whole earth will perish, and the water of the flood is about to come upon the whole earth, and it will destroy all that is upon it.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ νῦν δίδαξον αὐτὸν ὅπως ἐκφύγῃ, καὶ μενεῖ τὸ σπέρμα αὐτοῦ εἰς πάσας τὰς γενεὰς τοῦ αἰῶνος.
paragraphs.translit: Kai nyn didaxon auton hopōs ekphygē, kai menei to sperma autou eis pasas tas geneas tou aiōnos.

i18n.en: And now teach him, that he may escape, and that his seed may endure throughout all the generations of the age.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ πάλιν εἶπεν ὁ κύριος τῷ Ῥαφαὴλ· Δῆσον τὸν Ἀζαὴλ ποσὶν καὶ χερσίν, καὶ βάλε αὐτὸν εἰς τὸ σκότος, καὶ ἄνοιξον τὴν ἔρημον τὴν οὖσαν ἐν Δουδαὴλ, καὶ ἐκεῖ βάλε αὐτόν.
paragraphs.translit: Kai palin eipen ho kyrios tō Rhaphaēl; Dēson ton Azaēl posin kai chersin, kai bale auton eis to skotos, kai anoixon tēn erēmon tēn ousan en Doudaēl, kai ekei bale auton.

i18n.en: And again the Lord said to Raphael: Bind Asael hand and foot, and cast him into the darkness; and make an opening in the wilderness which is in Dudael, and there cast him in.

notes.official: **The binding of Asael at Dudael.** Raphael is dispatched to bind Asael hand-and-foot, cast him into the wilderness opening in Dudael, cover him with darkness, place jagged-and-rough stones upon him, until the day of the great judgement when he shall be sent into the fire. The narrative is the foundational text on the Asael-as-archetypal-scapegoat-figure tradition — Reed 2005's foundational thesis that this is **directly continuous with the Lev 16 Yom Kippur Azazel scapegoat tradition** (the wilderness-site + stones + transfer-of-sin + eschatological-judgement framework). See central entry `watchers-bound-dudael-azazel-1-enoch-10-lev-16-yom-kippur-cross-corpus`. The Aramaic Dudael (*Dūdāʾēl*, perhaps 'the cauldron of God') and the Hebrew *ʿăzāzʾēl* are figures merged in transmission across the Greek and Ge'ez witnesses.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ ὑπόθες αὐτῷ τραχεῖς καὶ ὀξεῖς λίθους, καὶ ἐπικάλυψον αὐτῷ τὸ σκότος, καὶ οἰκείτω ἐκεῖ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα, καὶ τὴν ὄψιν αὐτοῦ πώμασον καὶ φῶς μὴ θεωρείτω.
paragraphs.translit: Kai hypothes autō tracheis kai oxeis lithous, kai epikalypson autō to skotos, kai oikeitō ekei eis ton aiōna, kai tēn opsin autou pōmason kai phōs mē theōreitō.

i18n.en: And place upon him rough and jagged stones, and cover him with darkness, and let him dwell there forever; and cover his face, that he may not see the light.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῆς μεγάλης κρίσεως ἀπενεχθήσεται εἰς τὸν ἐμπυρισμόν.
paragraphs.translit: Kai en tē hēmera tēs megalēs kriseōs apenechthēsetai eis ton empyrismon.

i18n.en: And on the day of the great judgment, he shall be cast into the burning.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ ἴασαι τὴν γῆν, ἣν ἠφάνισαν οἱ ἐγρήγοροι, καὶ τὴν ἴασιν τῆς γῆς δήλωσον, ἵνα ἰάσωνται τὴν πληγὴν καὶ μὴ ἀπολῶνται πάντες οἱ υἱοὶ τῶν ἀνθρώπων ἐν τῷ μυστηρίῳ τῷ ὅλῳ ᾧ κατέλιπον οἱ ἐγρήγοροι καὶ ἐδίδαξαν τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτῶν.
paragraphs.translit: Kai iasai tēn gēn, hēn ēphanisan hoi egrēgoroi, kai tēn iasin tēs gēs dēlōson, hina iasōntai tēn plēgēn kai mē apolōntai pantes hoi huioi tōn anthrōpōn en tō mystēriō tō holō hō katelipon hoi egrēgoroi kai edidaxan tous huious autōn.

i18n.en: And heal the earth, which the Watchers have corrupted; and proclaim the healing of the earth, that they may heal the plague, and that not all the sons of men may perish through the whole mystery which the Watchers handed down and taught to their sons.

notes.official: 'all the earth which the Watchers have corrupted' — the foundational etiology-of-corruption framework that the Watcher-tradition supplies. The earth itself is presented as the **victim** of the Watchers' transgression; the binding of Asael and Šemiḥazah is presented as the divine-action of cosmic-cleansing.

paragraphs.text: καὶ ἠφανίσθη πᾶσα ἡ γῆ ἐν τῷ ἔργῳ τῆς διδασκαλίας Ἀζαήλ, καὶ ἐπ' αὐτὸν γράψον πάσας τὰς ἁμαρτίας.
paragraphs.translit: kai ēphanisthē pasa hē gē en tō ergō tēs didaskalias Azaēl, kai ep' auton grapson pasas tas hamartias.

i18n.en: For the whole earth has been corrupted by the work of the teaching of Asael; and against him write down all the sins.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ τῷ Γαβριὴλ εἶπεν ὁ κύριος· Πορεύου ἐπὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς τῶν πορνῶν καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς ἐκλεκτοὺς καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς τῶν Ἐγρηγόρων· καὶ ἀπόλεσον τοὺς υἱοὺς τῶν πορνῶν καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς τῶν Ἐγρηγόρων ἐκ τῶν ἀνθρώπων, καὶ ἔκβαλε αὐτούς, καὶ ἀπόστειλον αὐτοὺς πρὸς ἑαυτούς, ἵνα ἀπόλωνται ἑαυτοὺς ἐν αὐτοῖς ἐν πολέμῳ ἀπωλείας, διότι μακρότης ἡμερῶν οὐκ ἔσται αὐτοῖς.
paragraphs.translit: Kai tō Gabriēl eipen ho kyrios; Poreuou epi tous huious tōn pornōn kai epi tous eklektous kai epi tous huious tōn Egrēgorōn; kai apoleson tous huious tōn pornōn kai tous huious tōn Egrēgorōn ek tōn anthrōpōn, kai ekbale autous, kai aposteilon autous pros heautous, hina apolōntai heautous en autois en polemō apōleias, dioti makrotēs hēmerōn ouk estai autois.

i18n.en: And to Gabriel the Lord said: Go against the bastards and the reprobates and against the sons of the Watchers; and destroy the sons of the Watchers from among men, and drive them out, and send them against one another, that they may destroy each other in battle, for length of days shall not be theirs.

notes.official: The Watcher-leader Šemiḥazah and the other Watchers are bound for seventy generations until the final judgement (1 En 10:11-16); the giants are destroyed in inter-giants warfare. The 'seventy generations' establishes the eschatological-timeframe — the present age is the intermediate-state awaiting the cosmic-judgement.

paragraphs.text: καὶ πᾶσα ἐρώτησις οὐκ ἔσται τοῖς πατράσιν αὐτῶν περὶ αὐτῶν, ὅτι ἐλπίζουσιν ζῆσαι ζωὴν αἰώνιον, καὶ ὅτι ζήσεται ἕκαστος αὐτῶν ἔτη πεντακόσια.
paragraphs.translit: kai pasa erōtēsis ouk estai tois patrasin autōn peri autōn, hoti elpizousin zēsai zōēn aiōnion, kai hoti zēsetai hekastos autōn etē pentakosia.

i18n.en: And no petition shall be granted to their fathers on their behalf, though they hope to live an eternal life, and that each of them shall live five hundred years.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ τῷ Μιχαὴλ εἶπεν ὁ κύριος· Πορεύου, Μιχαήλ, καὶ δῆσον Σεμιαζᾶν καὶ τοὺς ἄλλους τοὺς σὺν αὐτῷ τοὺς συμμιγέντας τοῖς θηλείαις τοῦ μιανθῆναι ἐν αὐταῖς ἐν τῇ ἀκαθαρσίᾳ αὐτῶν.
paragraphs.translit: Kai tō Michaēl eipen ho kyrios; Poreuou, Michaēl, kai dēson Semiazan kai tous allous tous syn autō tous symmigentas tois thēleiais tou mianthēnai en autais en tē akatharsia autōn.

i18n.en: And to Michael the Lord said: Go, Michael, and bind Šemiḥazah and the others with him, who have united themselves with the women, so that they have defiled themselves with them in their uncleanness.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ ὅταν κατασφαγῶσιν οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτῶν, καὶ ἴδωσιν τὴν ἀπώλειαν τῶν ἀγαπητῶν αὐτῶν, δῆσον αὐτοὺς ἑβδομήκοντα γενεὰς εἰς τὰς νάπας τῆς γῆς μέχρι ἡμέρας κρίσεως αὐτῶν καὶ συντελείας, ἕως τοῦ τελεσθῆναι κρίμα τοῦ αἰῶνος τῶν αἰώνων.
paragraphs.translit: Kai hotan katasphagōsin hoi huioi autōn, kai idōsin tēn apōleian tōn agapētōn autōn, dēson autous hebdomēkonta geneas eis tas napas tēs gēs mechri hēmeras kriseōs autōn kai synteleias, heōs tou telesthēnai krima tou aiōnos tōn aiōnōn.

i18n.en: And when their sons are slaughtered, and they see the destruction of their beloved ones, bind them for seventy generations in the valleys of the earth, until the day of their judgment and of their consummation, until the eternal judgment is completed.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις ἀπενεχθήσονται εἰς τὸν δεσμωτήριον τὸν ἄσβεστον τοῦ πυρὸς εἰς τὸ καυτήριον καὶ εἰς ἀφανισμὸν τοῦ αἰῶνος.
paragraphs.translit: Kai en tais hēmerais ekeinais apenechthēsontai eis ton desmōtērion ton asbeston tou pyros eis to kautērion kai eis aphanismon tou aiōnos.

i18n.en: And in those days they shall be led away to the abyss of fire, to the torment and to the prison in which they shall be confined forever.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ πᾶς ὃς ἂν κατακριθῇ καὶ ἀφανισθῇ ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν σὺν αὐτοῖς, μέχρι συντελείας γενεᾶς δεθήσονται.
paragraphs.translit: Kai pas hos an katakrithē kai aphanisthē apo tou nyn syn autois, mechri synteleias geneas dethēsontai.

i18n.en: And whoever from now on shall be condemned and destroyed along with them shall be bound with them until the consummation of their generation.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ ἀπόλεσον πάντα τὰ πνεύματα τῶν κιβδήλων καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς τῶν Ἐγρηγόρων, διότι ἠδίκησαν τοὺς ἀνθρώπους.
paragraphs.translit: Kai apoleson panta ta pneumata tōn kibdēlōn kai tous huious tōn Egrēgorōn, dioti ēdikēsan tous anthrōpous.

i18n.en: And destroy all the spirits of the bastards and the sons of the Watchers, because they have wronged mankind.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ ἀπόλεσον πᾶσαν ἀδικίαν ἀπὸ προσώπου τῆς γῆς, καὶ πᾶν ἔργον ἀδικίας ἐκλιπέτω· καὶ ἐμφανήτω τὸ φυτὸν τῆς δικαιοσύνης καὶ τῆς ἀληθείας, καὶ ἔσται εἰς εὐλογίαν τὸ ἔργον τῆς δικαιοσύνης, καὶ ἐν ἀληθείᾳ φυτευθήσεται εἰς εὐφροσύνην τοῦ αἰῶνος.
paragraphs.translit: Kai apoleson pasan adikian apo prosōpou tēs gēs, kai pan ergon adikias eklipetō; kai emphanētō to phyton tēs dikaiosynēs kai tēs alētheias, kai estai eis eulogian to ergon tēs dikaiosynēs, kai en alētheia phyteuthēsetai eis euphrosynēn tou aiōnos.

i18n.en: And destroy all unrighteousness from the face of the earth, and let every work of unrighteousness come to an end; and let the plant of righteousness and of truth appear, and the work of righteousness shall be a blessing, and it shall be planted in truth as joy forever.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ νῦν πάντες οἱ δίκαιοι ἐκφεύξονται, καὶ ἔσονται ζῶντες μέχρις οὗ γεννήσωσιν χιλιάδας, καὶ πᾶσαι αἱ ἡμέραι τῆς νεότητος αὐτῶν καὶ τοῦ σαββατισμοῦ αὐτῶν ἐν εἰρήνῃ τελεσθήσονται.
paragraphs.translit: Kai nyn pantes hoi dikaioi ekpheuxontai, kai esontai zōntes mechris hou gennēsōsin chiliadas, kai pasai hai hēmerai tēs neotētos autōn kai tou sabbatismou autōn en eirēnē telesthēsontai.

i18n.en: And now all the righteous shall escape, and shall live until they beget thousands; and all the days of their youth and their sabbath rest shall be completed in peace.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ τότε ἐργασθήσεται πᾶσα ἡ γῆ ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ, καὶ φυτευθήσεται δένδρον ἐν αὐτῇ, καὶ πληρωθήσεται εὐλογίας.
paragraphs.translit: Kai tote ergasthēsetai pasa hē gē en dikaiosynē, kai phyteuthēsetai dendron en autē, kai plērōthēsetai eulogias.

i18n.en: And then shall the whole earth be tilled in righteousness, and trees shall be planted in it, and it shall be filled with blessing.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ πάντα τὰ δένδρα τῆς εὐφροσύνης φυτευθήσονται ἐν αὐτῇ, καὶ ἄμπελοι φυτευθήσονται ἐν αὐτῇ, καὶ ἡ ἄμπελος ἡ φυτευθήσομενη ἐν αὐτῇ οἴνου ποιήσει εἰς πλησμονήν, καὶ πᾶν σπέρμα τὸ σπειρόμενον ἐπ' αὐτῆς, ἓν μέτρον ποιήσει χιλίους, καὶ μέτρον ἑλαιῶν ποιήσει βάτους δέκα.
paragraphs.translit: Kai panta ta dendra tēs euphrosynēs phyteuthēsontai en autē, kai ampeloi phyteuthēsontai en autē, kai hē ampelos hē phyteuthēsomenē en autē oinou poiēsei eis plēsmonēn, kai pan sperma to speiromenon ep' autēs, hen metron poiēsei chilious, kai metron elaiōn poiēsei batous deka.

i18n.en: And all the trees of joy shall be planted in it, and vines shall be planted in it; and the vine which is planted in it shall yield wine in abundance; and as for every seed that is sown in it, each measure shall yield a thousand, and each measure of olives shall yield ten baths.

paragraphs.text: Καθαρίσατε τὴν γῆν ἀπὸ πάσης ἀδικίας καὶ ἀπὸ πάσης ἀκαθαρσίας καὶ ἀπὸ πάσης ὀργῆς καὶ ἀπὸ πάσης μάστιγος.
paragraphs.translit: Katharisate tēn gēn apo pasēs adikias kai apo pasēs akatharsias kai apo pasēs orgēs kai apo pasēs mastigos.

i18n.en: Cleanse the earth from all unrighteousness, and from all uncleanness, and from all wrath, and from all plague.

paragraphs.text: καὶ ἔσονται πάντες οἱ υἱοὶ τῶν ἀνθρώπων δίκαιοι, καὶ πάντα τὰ ἔθνη λατρεύσουσιν καὶ εὐλογήσουσιν αὐτῷ, καὶ πάντες προσκυνήσουσιν.
paragraphs.translit: kai esontai pantes hoi huioi tōn anthrōpōn dikaioi, kai panta ta ethnē latreusousin kai eulogēsousin autō, kai pantes proskynēsousin.

i18n.en: And all the sons of men shall be righteous, and all the nations shall serve and bless him, and all shall worship.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ καθαρισθήσεται ἡ γῆ ἀπὸ πάσης ἀκαθαρσίας καὶ ἀπὸ πάσης ἀνομίας καὶ ἀπὸ πάσης ἁμαρτίας, καὶ ὀργῆν καὶ μάστιγα οὐκέτι μὴ ἀποστείλω ἐπ' αὐτὴν εἰς πάσας τὰς γενεὰς τοῦ αἰῶνος.
paragraphs.translit: Kai katharisthēsetai hē gē apo pasēs akatharsias kai apo pasēs anomias kai apo pasēs hamartias, kai orgēn kai mastiga ouketi mē aposteilō ep' autēn eis pasas tas geneas tou aiōnos.

i18n.en: And the earth shall be cleansed from all uncleanness, and from all lawlessness, and from all sin; and I will not again send wrath and plague upon it throughout all the generations of the age.
